rci6_sex.detail: Training phase; Table 1 column header reads 'Gender (male)' but this appears mislabeled — the text states '91 FEDN-MDD patients (60 females)' yet Table 1 shows 60 for FEDN-MDD in that same column, indicating the column actually represents female counts. This is further supported by Table 2 which uses the header 'Gender (female)' for subtype comparisons (Subtype I=10, Subtype II=49, total=59 ≈ 60 females minus 2 excluded). Therefore healthy-base female_n=65; male_n=26 estimated by subtraction (91−65).
